summary: Hands-on mobile engineering leader with 10+ years in software engineering, 8+ years shipping Android, iOS, and React Native apps for Walmart Global Tech (500K+ daily users), HCSC (1M+ members), and IBM/AEP, and 6+ years leading teams of 5–7 engineers while still writing production code. Leads mobile and web front ends together: React Native apps aligned with Next.js / React (TypeScript) web apps (SSR/SSG, Core Web Vitals). Specializes in brownfield migration: embedding React Native into existing Kotlin/Java Android and Swift/Objective-C iOS apps with Electrode Native micro-frontends, native module bridging, and the new architecture (TurboModules, JSI, Fabric), while holding hybrid startup, memory, and crash-free (99.9%) targets. Owns mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Expo EAS, fastlane), App Store and Google Play releases with phased rollouts and feature flags, and performance monitoring (Dynatrace, Crashlytics, Sentry). Runs hiring, 1:1s, code review standards, and architecture decisions with product, backend, QA, and security.
